text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"30"}],"comment":"The M8 threaded hole (feature F1, dimension D11) will receive a zinc plating (I.Z.B.P.) but the drawing does not specify an allowance for plating thickness on the thread pitch diameter. The designer should add a note or adjust the pre-plate tap size to account for the plating build-up so the thread gages correctly after coating.","recommended_correction":"Specify the pre-plate thread tolerance class or add a note stating the plating thickness allowance for the M8 thread."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC."}],"comment":"The heat treatment specifies a hardness range but does not state at which manufacturing stage it is to be applied (e.g., before final machining, before surface treatment). Without this, the machinist and heat treater cannot sequence operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features. The designer should add the process stage to the heat treatment callout.","recommended_correction":"Update the heat treatment specification to include the stage, e.g., 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 24-32 HRC PRIOR TO FINAL MACHINING'."}]}
